+title: AgentEnvironment and the model match table
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §3 (the host makes the dependencies), §7.
+
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentEnvironment.swift`: `public struct AgentEnvironment: Sendable` with `profile: LanguageModelProfile`, `skills: SkillsRegistry`, `workingDirectory: URL`, `tools: ToolCatalog`, `defaultSlot: ModelSlot = .standard`, `maxConcurrentAgents`, `maxDepth = 3`, `maxRetainedRuns`, `budget: @Sendable (Int) -> TokenBudget?` (default `TokenBudget(limit:)`). No default for `profile` or `skills`.
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/ModelMatch.swift`: `func match(_ model: String?, profile:, inherited: ModelSlot) -> (slot: ModelSlot, warning: String?)`:
+  - absent or `inherit`: `inherited`.
+  - `standard` or `flash`: that slot.
+  - equal to `chosen.stringValue` of a slot, or to its part before `@`: that slot; `standard` when the two slots share a model.
+  - other (`opus`, `sonnet`, `embedding`, unknown): a warning, then `inherited`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each row of the §7 table gives the stated slot, with the scripted profile.
+- [ ] A shared model reference gives `.standard`.
+- [ ] `model: sonnet` gives a warning and `inherited`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/ModelMatchTests.swift`, one case per row.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter ModelMatchTests`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+    Research and implementation notes:
+    - `ModelRef.repo` is internal in the Router. The match thus splits `chosen.stringValue` at the first `@` to get the part before `@`.
+    - `ModelMatch` (internal enum, Run/ModelMatch.swift): `match(_:profile:inherited:) -> (slot:, warning:)`. It uses a table `generationSlots` (standard first, then flash) with a `KeyPath<LanguageModelProfile, RoutedLLM> & Sendable`. Slot names come first, then the model references. Because standard is first, a shared reference gives `.standard`. The match does not use the case.
+    - The warning names the value, the profile, the slot that the run uses, and the valid values.
+    - `AgentEnvironment` (public struct, Run/AgentEnvironment.swift): profile and skills have no default. Defaults: workingDirectory = `URL.currentDirectory()`, tools = `ToolCatalog()`, defaultSlot = `.standard`, maxConcurrentAgents = 4, maxDepth = 3, maxRetainedRuns = 100, budget = `TokenBudget(limit:)`. Preconditions: defaultSlot is standard or flash, maxConcurrentAgents >= 1, maxDepth >= 1, maxRetainedRuns >= 0. Exit tests (`#expect(processExitsWith: .failure)`) pin the preconditions. I made one fail on purpose to show that it can fail.
+    - `ScriptedProfile.make` got `standard:` and `flash:` model parameters (defaults unchanged), for the shared and pinned profiles.
